adoption.decision_rationale: Franklin error categories are useful, but retries are admitted only through target idempotency, reconciliation, token, cost, attempt, and delay budgets.
adoption.invariant: Transient errors may be retried only within explicit replay budgets.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: A non-idempotent ambiguous operation is never retried without reconciliation.
adoption.value_unit: provider error taxonomy and replay-aware recovery

adoption.decision_rationale: Useful redaction patterns were adapted into the existing security module instead of introducing a parallel logger.
adoption.invariant: Common encoded and labelled secret forms are removed before reporting.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Redaction never stores or reveals the original secret.

adoption.decision_rationale: The independent target model preserves measured benefit, cost, disable flag, and non-execution without importing Franklin runtime code.
adoption.invariant: Components are retained only when explicit metrics justify their operational cost.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Harness evaluation never invokes the component or grants authority.

adoption.decision_rationale: Permission vocabulary is intersected with target policy; donor wildcard or money-movement requests cannot self-authorize.
adoption.invariant: Admitted permissions equal the explicit requested/allowed intersection.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Wildcards and unadmitted money movement never grant authority.

adoption.decision_rationale: Skill text remains searchable metadata and can enter only the bounded target quarantine lifecycle.
adoption.invariant: Every skill artifact is hashed and remains quarantined until role-separated review.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No donor script, trigger, or permission activates during intake.

adoption.decision_rationale: The scoring concept is layered on the existing Decimal FIFO journal report and cannot mutate trades.
adoption.invariant: Quality deductions are explicit and reproducible from the journal report.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: A quality score never grants trading authority.

adoption.decision_rationale: Target parity compares normalized intents and source hashes rather than adopting the donor wallet/router.
adoption.invariant: Equivalent modes emit equivalent normalized intents under the same dataset and configuration.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Live-shadow evidence cannot claim an executed order.
adoption.value_unit: unified backtest paper and live-shadow lifecycle

adoption.decision_rationale: Wallet custody conflicts with target separation of duties and external signer boundaries, so only a negative invariant is adopted.
adoption.invariant: Economic metadata may be assessed without wallet authority.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No donor wallet, private key, signer, or broadcaster is registered as a safe tool.
adoption.value_unit: embedded wallet and live execution authority

adoption.decision_rationale: The useful headless UX is implemented with bounded Unicode-aware rendering and existing Typer commands, not the donor UI runtime.
adoption.invariant: Terminal output is bounded and display-width aware.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Terminal state never becomes authoritative or embeds credentials.

adoption.decision_rationale: Protocol fields are normalized behind the target budget and governance planes; licence inconsistency and wallet code prevent direct reuse.
adoption.invariant: Challenges are validated, hashed, expiry-bound, and budget-reserved before any external payment path.
adoption.license_note: MIT licence file; package metadata ISC
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No local signing, broadcasting, or funds movement occurs.

adoption.decision_rationale: Chain signing and payment execution are deliberately excluded from the target process.
adoption.invariant: Receipts bind challenge, reservation, amount, verifier, time, and verification hash.
adoption.license_note: MIT licence file; package metadata ISC
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Receipt presence cannot claim local signer invocation or broadcast.

adoption.decision_rationale: Dynamic discovery is converted to non-executing descriptors, schema hashes, output bounds, and the existing financial gateway manifest.
adoption.invariant: Remote metadata is validated before it can be reviewed.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Catalogue ingestion never starts a server, resolves a credential, or calls a tool.

adoption.decision_rationale: Untrusted names are normalized with collision-resistant suffixing and bounded length.
adoption.invariant: Tool IDs are deterministic, bounded, and collision checked.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Names cannot inject paths, shell syntax, or implicit authority.

adoption.decision_rationale: Read shapes are normalized into strict target models; provider calls, writes, and API credentials are excluded.
adoption.invariant: External IDs and references are validated before any operator review.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Snapshot assessment never imports authoritative balances or moves funds.

adoption.decision_rationale: Multiple donor tool families collapse into one bounded read-only snapshot rather than many write-capable MCP tools.
adoption.invariant: All imported values are typed, finite, bounded, and source hashed.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No credentials are resolved and no external record is modified.
adoption.value_unit: budgets recurring items categories tags and crypto balances

adoption.decision_rationale: Deterministic union-find and explicit bounds are retained; donor networking and attribution assumptions are excluded.
adoption.invariant: Clusters derive only from explicit interaction evidence and thresholds.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Address proximity never asserts identity or wallet control.

adoption.decision_rationale: Pagination and concentration concepts are normalized with item caps, cursors, evidence hashes, and no network authority.
adoption.invariant: Pages are bounded and concentration is deterministic from explicit holdings.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No chain result is treated as final without qualified evidence.
adoption.value_unit: token holder pagination and response shape

adoption.decision_rationale: Useful report shapes and specialist workflow vocabulary are converted to typed evidence bundles and non-advisory reports.
adoption.invariant: Every displayed claim resolves to timestamped hashed evidence.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: A finance panel never becomes advice, portfolio mutation, or order authority.

adoption.decision_rationale: Skill descriptions and source hashes remain discoverable while scripts and triggers stay quarantined.
adoption.invariant: Skill provenance and licence remain visible for review.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Search results never execute a skill or register a trigger.

adoption.decision_rationale: BUSL restrictions and authority conflicts preclude source reuse; compatible bounded fallback concepts are independently implemented.
adoption.invariant: Fallbacks remain admitted, bounded, and non-authoritative.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: No BUSL source is copied into the authoritative Python runtime.

adoption.decision_rationale: The lifecycle is independently implemented with stronger role separation, CAS, integrity hashes, and executable quarantine.
adoption.invariant: Skill activation requires distinct roles and an intact record revision.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Evidence-only packages with code or permissions cannot activate.

adoption.decision_rationale: Agent-initiated charging conflicts with target external signer, budget, and governance boundaries.
adoption.invariant: Payment plans require existing budgets and remain unsigned.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Agents cannot initiate payment, resolve wallet keys, or broadcast.
adoption.value_unit: inflow payment and agent charging authority

adoption.decision_rationale: Permissively licensed source is preserved intact outside runtime packages for future qualified comparison and optional promotion.
adoption.invariant: Source identity and licence are preserved without default build membership.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Source presence never implies build, correctness, constant-time, audit, or activation.
adoption.value_unit: SM2 SM3 SM4 TLCP implementation source

adoption.decision_rationale: Known-answer, negative, fuzz, timing, and external-oracle status are explicit target evidence fields.
adoption.invariant: Only executed vectors can pass and build claims require a compiler.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Static inspection cannot establish constant-time behaviour or independent audit.

adoption.decision_rationale: The list supplies search vocabulary and negative lessons, but incomplete licence evidence prevents copying its prose or treating links as endorsed.
adoption.invariant: Catalogue records exact source hash and reference-only status.
adoption.migration_impact: additive target-native contract; no authoritative-state migration
adoption.negative_invariant: Links are never followed or executed by ingestion.
